verdict.rationale: Ollama documents a dedicated 'ollama launch' command that sets up and runs coding tools like Claude Code, OpenCode, and Codex pre-configured with local or cloud models, with no env vars or config files needed, plus explicit one-command launch messaging for Claude Code and Codex. Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation of the launch UX from community sources and broader coverage of exactly which agents beyond the named few are supported.
